name: events-ui
description: UI reactiva sobre un log de eventos en SQLite para monitorizar repositorios.

scripts.check: corepack pnpm check:ui && corepack pnpm check:py && corepack pnpm check:rust
scripts.check:py: uv run --directory services/core ruff check . && uv run --directory services/core ruff format --check .
scripts.fix: uv run --directory services/core ruff check --fix . && uv run --directory services/core ruff format . && corepack pnpm --filter desktop exec eslint . --fix
